description: This file defines the SeoUrl class within the Opencart\'s Catalog Model\Design namespace. The class provides methods to retrieve SEO URL data from the database by keyword or key-value pairs, specifically within an OpenCart store context.

classes.name: SeoUrl
classes.description: A model class for interacting with SEO URL data in the database, offering methods to retrieve SEO URL information based on keywords or key-value pairs.

methods.name: getSeoUrlByKeyword
methods.description: Retrieves SEO URL data from the database matching the provided keyword, considering store context.

methods.name: getSeoUrlByKeyValue
methods.description: Retrieves SEO URL data matching specific key and value pairs, considering store and language context.
